actual_published_context.claim: Primary human intact monocyte/derived macrophage gene/protein measurements establish nonmalignant myeloid contribution as plausible; not EMC covariance or localization.

Human/mouse GBM bulk/scRNA/spatial plus compartment validation reports macrophage-derived GPNMB; general macrophage-source interpretation is established prior art, not a novel EMC cell-source inference.
Published TCGA bulk sarcoma GPNMB expression context excludes EMC/LGFMS/MLPS from enumerated seven subtypes; does not answer the fixed native EMC covariance question.

Primary global gene-expression clustering and public selectable expression source are prior art. Previously permitted text review does not establish that an exact GPNMB/myeloid/stromal covariance/use claim is absent.

actual_published_context.source: Brenca2019 DOI10.1002/path.5284 and existing immune-deconvolution sources
actual_published_context.claim: Partner-related transcription and published immune contexts already exist. Exact fixed GPNMB covariance may be unreported, but missing case/capture/processed maps and limited permissible primary-art review prevent novelty proof.

useful_unanswered_use: If fixed all-condition within-assay marker covariance reproducibly identifies which EMC specimens should be selected for macrophage-versus-stromal-versus-malignant localization assays, it can guide a concrete future sampling experiment. A generic positive correlation alone, or a macrophage-origin declaration from bulk RNA, adds little beyond established compartment biology.
strongest_contrary: Old high recurrent EMC condition must remain; lower primary-tissue GPNMB versus another histotype does not imply uniform absence or cell origin. Small ranges, shared reference/probe capture, cell-mixture and handling can produce correlations. All marker and probe outcomes, including unfavorable and null, must be retained.
current_prior_art_disposition: No exact native EMC fixed-panel covariance/use finding authenticated in these reused permitted primary records; this is not a proof of novelty or literature exhaustion. No new network or fullbody endpoint inspection performed.
not_required: Protein pairing is not a universal prerequisite for a useful RNA-only sampling association, and absent LGFMS controls are irrelevant to the within-EMC estimand. Actual localization/cell identity claims do require an appropriate independent measurement.
promotion: HOLD, not new biological finding; useful correlation analysis requires separate meaningful frozen question, complete feasible marker/assay rules, root numerical authorization and all-public coverage follow-through.
